source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Use specific serial numbers and test unit information.
3. Collect all relevant performance data.
4. Compare the test data against the advertised specs.
5. Identify discrepancies.
6. Record any deviations in a clear and concise manner.
7. Include photographs, video, or other unambiguous evidence when available.
8. Detail the conditions under which the tests were conducted.
9. Include details of the apparatus and methods used for the testing.
10. Reference the specific part of the advertising that claimed the specification.
11. Explain how the failure impacts the product's usability or safety.
12. Ensure report is structured, with headings separating different sections (e.g., Introduction, Test Procedure, Results, Analysis, Conclusion).
13. Document any variations in the product manufacturing that could have caused the failure.
14. Compare the results to industry standards or benchmark products.
15. List any additional specifications that were not met, even if not advertised.
16. Cross-reference with other reports
